ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the graph of changes in the proportions of China's population aged 10-14 and 55-59, and answer the following questions. <image1> Taking ages 15—60 as the labor force population, in which period was the proportion of China's labor force population the highest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The horizontal axis in the figure is years, marking time points such as 1989, 1994, 1999, 2004, 2009, and 2014; the vertical axis is population proportion. The two curves respectively represent the proportions of China's population aged 10—14 and aged 55—59. In the figure, the curve for the proportion of the population aged 10—14 is relatively high around 2000 and then generally declines; the curve for the proportion of the population aged 55—59 gradually rises from a relatively low level. The two curves intersect around 2009; before 2009, the proportion of the population aged 10—14 is greater than the proportion of the population aged 55—59, and after 2009, the proportion of the population aged 55—59 exceeds the proportion of the population aged 10—14. Then reason: The question stem specifies ages 15—60 as the labor force population. The population aged 10—14 can be regarded as the reserve population about to enter the labor force age group, and the population aged 55—59 can be regarded as the population about to exit the labor force age group. Before 2009, the proportion of the reserve population entering the labor force was relatively high, exceeding those about to exit, so the proportion of the labor force population was still rising; around 2009 the two lines intersect, and afterward those about to exit exceed those about to enter, so the proportion of the labor force population begins to decline. Therefore, the period when the proportion of China's labor force population was the highest should appear in the adjacent period after this turning point, namely 2009—2014.

method.method_draft: 根据题干确定劳动力年龄为15—60岁。先从图中找10—14岁与55—59岁两条曲线的相对关系：2009年前10—14岁比重大于55—59岁，说明进入劳动力的后备人口多于即将退出者，劳动力比重仍在提高；2009年左右两线相交，之后55—59岁超过10—14岁，说明劳动力比重开始下降。因此最高点出现在交叉后的相邻时段，即2009—2014年。

再推理：题干规定15—60岁为劳动力人口。10—14岁人口可看作即将进入劳动力年龄段的后备人口，55—59岁人口可看作即将退出劳动力年龄段的人口。2009年前，进入劳动力的后备人口比重较高，超过即将退出者，因此劳动力人口比重仍在上升；2009年左右两线相交，之后即将退出者超过即将进入者，劳动力人口比重开始下降。所以我国劳动力人口比重最高的时段应出现在这个转折后的相邻时段，即2009—2014年。

method.method_draft: 按5年间隔估读两组人口比重并比较差值：1989、1994、1999、2004年10—14岁均高于55—59岁，差值为正，所以劳动力人口比重持续上升；到2009年两者约相等，增幅接近零；2014年前后55—59岁已高于10—14岁，差值转负，说明之后劳动力比重下降。由“先增后降”的累计变化判断，最高时段应落在由平衡点开始的2009—2014年。
method.CoT_raw:
